result.Method of Attack: Contains TurkoRat open-source info-stealer malware that steals account login credentials, cryptocurrency wallets, and website cookies; malware includes anti-sandbox and analysis evasion techniques; disguised malware as legitimate package dependencies (e.g., axios-proxy); typosquatting and social engineering by mimicking legitimate package names (e.g., readme.md file named agent-base, a legitimate package)
result.Attack Vector: Supply chain attack via malicious npm packages uploaded to public repository; social engineering through deceptive package naming and dependency injection
result.Indicators of Compromise: Package names: nodejs-encrypt-agent, nodejs-cookie-proxy-agent; dependency named axios-proxy imported in nodejs-cookie-proxy-agent; readme.md file named agent-base in nodejs-encrypt-agent; TurkoRat info-stealer malware presence; approximately 1,200 total downloads (500 for nodejs-encrypt-agent, fewer than 700 for nodejs-cookie-proxy-agent); removed from npm repository after disclosure
